scenes.subtitle: Numbers in a video
scenes.narration: Vaccines are one of the most important tools in medicine, so let us see how they actually work.

scenes.label: fewer severe cases
scenes.narration: In many trials, the rate of severe disease fell by around ninety five percent in vaccinated people.

scenes.title: Why it matters
scenes.narration: That protection goes beyond the individual, because fewer infections also shield people who cannot be vaccinated.
That is how vaccines protect you and everyone around you, one small step at a time.
